basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: I build software that solves real problems for real people. Technology is a means, not an end — I focus on outcomes, clarity, and long-term value.

work.name: tde
work.summary: Full-stack developer contributing to the design and development of scalable, data-centric applications that transform operational drilling data into actionable business insights. Work spanned React frontends, TypeScript/Node-based services, Kotlin/Spring APIs, and secure cloud infrastructure.
highlights: Designed and implemented full-stack solutions using React, TypeScript, Kotlin/Spring Boot, and .NET, focusing on robust analytics tools for the oil & gas sector
Built interactive data visualizations for field engineers and analysts to monitor real-time drilling KPIs and performance metrics
Developed automated pipelines for secure document parsing and uploading via APIs and email integration, processing large volumes of client reports
Created a flexible user management system with fine-grained permissions using Keycloak, supporting roles, groups, and access control policies
Integrated an AI-powered assistant using Amazon Bedrock, allowing users to query systems, invoke APIs, and generate technical documentation via chat
Participated in agile ceremonies and collaborated closely with product managers, QA, and design to ensure a fast feedback loop and delivery cadence

work.name: tde
work.summary: Delivered business intelligence and analytics solutions for drilling operations. Translated client needs into dashboards, reports, and custom tooling to improve data visibility and operational performance.
highlights: Created interactive Power BI dashboards to visualize drilling KPIs and operational metrics
Developed custom Excel plugins (VBA) for internal automation and reporting
Conducted training sessions and live demos for engineers and analysts, enabling adoption of analytics tools in field operations
Advised clients on process optimization using data insights and historical trend analysis
